You've cast four or more spells this turn.

easyPrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding two mana that includes {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Primeval Protector by paying {G}, causing Brinelin and Gwenna to trigger.
Resolve the Brinelin trigger, returning Thrasta from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding two mana that includes {G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Primeval Protector triggers when it enters, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Cast Thrasta by paying {G}{G}, causing Brinelin and Gwenna to trigger.
Resolve the Brinelin trigger, returning Primeval Protector from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.
